content.text: Exchanges are processed automatically with AML verification. The exchange rate is based on real-time spot market data and is floating, meaning it is calculated at the moment of processing according to current market conditions. The transaction requires network confirmations depending on the cryptocurrency and network. After the required confirmations are received, processing begins and may take up to 10 additional minutes. The final amount may vary depending on market fluctuations.
content.title: Exchange Information

seo.title: Identity Verification and AML Policy | QuickXchange
seo.description: Read the QuickXchange identity verification, source-of-funds, transaction review, and anti-money-laundering policy.

content.body: The AML Policy establishes the principles QuickXchange applies to identity verification, source-of-funds checks, suspicious-transaction review, user cooperation, and lawful information requests. It applies to users and transactions where verification or enhanced review is required.
content.title: Identity Verification and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Policy

sections.body:
1.1. The main objective of this AML Policy is to promote transparency, security, and transaction integrity, and to support compliance with international and domestic requirements intended to prevent illegal money turnover and criminal activity.

1.2. The Policy covers identity verification, source-of-funds verification, identification of suspicious transactions, and interaction with law-enforcement agencies where required in connection with suspected violations.
sections.heading: 1. Objectives of the Policy

sections.body:
2.1. Users may be required to complete identity verification to access Platform services. This requirement helps protect the Platform and its users from fraud and other prohibited activity.

2.2. Documents requested during registration, service use, or transaction review may include:

• Passport main page or front side.
• Passport second page or back side.
• Proof of residential address, such as a bank statement, utility bill, or address registration shown in a passport.

2.3. Where necessary, the Contractor may request additional documents to confirm a user’s identity or information relating to a specific transaction.

2.4. For suspicious transactions or elevated AML risk, the Contractor may request a photograph or video showing the user with an identity document, together with other evidence supporting the lawful source of funds.
sections.heading: 2. Identity Verification

sections.body:
3.1. The Contractor uses transaction-control procedures to identify suspicious activity. If a transaction requires additional review, the Contractor may temporarily suspend it for up to 14 days while the source of funds is verified.

3.2. A review may include:

• Transaction assessment using a specialized AML service, such as web.amlbot.com, to identify risk indicators and potentially unlawful funds.
• A request for a screenshot or video from the user’s crypto-wallet account.
• Analysis of source-of-funds information using available data, partner systems, and lawful requests from law-enforcement agencies.

3.3. Where transaction risk exceeds the acceptable level, the Contractor may:

• Freeze funds for up to 14 days.
• Return funds to the details from which they were sent, or to other details after completion of checks by the Platform’s security service.
sections.heading: 3. Verification of Sources of Funds and Transaction Suspension

sections.body:
4.1. By accepting the Platform’s Terms of Use, the user confirms that their funds have a lawful origin and agrees to provide complete, accurate, and current source-of-funds information when verification is required.

4.2. Users must cooperate fully by providing information reasonably necessary to meet the requirements of this AML Policy.

4.3. Failure to provide source-of-funds information, or the provision of false or misleading information, may result in funds being frozen. Where appropriate, the Contractor may cooperate with law-enforcement agencies to help return frozen funds to their rightful owners.
sections.heading: 4. User Responsibility and Cooperation

sections.body:
5.1. The Contractor takes measures intended to prevent abuse and uses transaction-monitoring methods to identify and block suspicious activity.

5.2. In exceptional cases, including where a user cannot adequately establish the source of funds or appears connected to persons suspected of criminal activity, the Contractor may require additional identity and source-of-funds verification.

5.3. The Contractor may refuse a transaction or terminate the agreement where the user does not comply with this AML Policy, subject to applicable law and the Platform’s Terms of Use.
sections.heading: 5. Measures to Prevent Violations

sections.body:
6.1. In the event of a Policy violation, false information, or refusal to cooperate, the Contractor may:

• Refuse to carry out the transaction.
• Freeze funds until verification is completed.
• Provide transaction and user information to law-enforcement agencies where a connection to criminal activity is confirmed and disclosure is lawful.

6.2. Frozen funds may be transferred to their rightful owners in response to a lawful request from the appropriate authorities.
sections.heading: 6. Consequences of Non-Compliance

sections.body:
7.1. Where a user cannot provide adequate confirmation of the source of funds, the Contractor may request additional documents or information needed to assess the legality of the user’s activity.

7.2. Where there is reasonable suspicion of involvement in unlawful activity, the Contractor may restrict account access and provide relevant information to law-enforcement agencies where permitted or required by law.
sections.heading: 7. Exceptional Circumstances

sections.body:
8.1. The Contractor undertakes to take reasonable measures to protect users and meet applicable AML requirements.

8.2. Users must follow Platform requirements, provide reliable information, and comply with the laws applicable in their jurisdiction.

This AML Policy supports a safer and more transparent environment for users of the Platform. User cooperation and compliance are essential to preventing misuse and maintaining trust.
sections.heading: 8. Obligations of the Contractor and the User

content.subtitle: This policy is designed to prevent illegal financial activity, strengthen the security of the financial environment for all users, and support compliance with applicable anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist-financing requirements.
